objective.en: Detect active wildfire cells quickly enough to support community evacuation planning.

sources.name: NASA FIRMS / VIIRS (reference dataset)
sources.usage: Hazard placement is an educational model inspired by FIRMS fire-detection products; cells are not current observations.

objective.en: Map flooded neighborhoods through cloud cover and deliver actionable coverage within 12 hours.

sources.name: NASA GPM IMERG and OPERA DSWx (reference datasets)
sources.usage: Flood and cloud patterns are educational models inspired by precipitation and surface-water products; cells are not current observations.

objective.en: Identify the hottest urban areas with sufficient accuracy to prioritize heat-response resources.

sources.name: NASA ECOSTRESS land-surface temperature (reference dataset)
sources.usage: Heat intensity is an educational model inspired by ECOSTRESS products; cells are not current observations.
